name: After Login/Logout Redirection
description: Per-role redirect destination applied after a user logs in and after a user logs out.
project_description: After Login/Logout Redirection (alr) lets a site administrator configure, per user role, an internal or external destination path that the user is sent to after logging in and after logging out. It ships a single settings form at /admin/config/alr-configuration with two draggable, weighted tables (one for login, one for logout) listing every non-anonymous role. On submit the per-role redirect_url and weight values are stored in the alr.settings simple configuration object. At runtime a submit handler added to the core user_login_form and an implementation of hook_user_logout look up the current user's first (alphabetically sorted) role, read its configured redirect_url, and, only when the request does not already carry a destination query parameter, set that destination so Drupal's normal redirect handling sends the user there. The module adds no entities, services, permissions, plugins, or Drush commands; the only route is the admin settings form, gated by the core 'administer site configuration' permission.
